additional_info.subject: RE: ID0472933-DC/Si-D/IT-[Y2 / S1 313483122003] CU logs check CRM:00263000371
additional_info.body:
Dear Filomena,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0472933
, following my colleague's previous analysis. There is only one symptom why the AC session did not start:
AC1:
contactor opened unexpectedly: stop charging
The logging "AC1:
SECC not longer requires closed contactor: stop charging"
is just a log line from SECC which is ignored by the charger. The issue of the failed session is then the contactor opened unexpectedly. There could many reason why this happens:
The AC contactor is actually faulty
The AC cable used is damaged
The EV is creating the issue
For what concern the AC charging, unfortunately there is no further analysis I can provide you to understand what is the cause of the issue, as the AC charging does not produce SECC logs, hence I cannot see the communication with the vehicle.
If the issue happened only this time on this charger with this EV, I would say the issue is related to the EV/ AC cable. If it happened also with other EVs, it might be the case to go onsite and check the AC contactor.
Please let me know if further support is needed, or if we can inform the regional colleagues and close the ticket.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
Siemens AG
eMobility Customer Service
Technical Support Engineer
SI E EU CS TS
Nonnendammallee 101
13629 Berlin, Germany
mailto:fosco.servidei@siemens.com
www.siemens.com

Thank you.
